summary: EFYL Address Book v2.0.0 — both backend and frontend tested end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass (100%), including new v2 features (low_accuracy/azimuth/lat_corrected fields on addresses, household survey with persons[] + commerce, GET/POST surveys, CSV export with all v2 columns, JSON export with nested survey, OTP rate-limit 429 after 4th request, OTP code single-use 401 on reuse, has_survey propagation on address GET, sync, verify with Haversine, delete cascade removes linked survey, /api/health returns twilio_enabled=false). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844 via Expo web preview): app loads through splash/onboarding/tabs OK, Home shows the 5 demo addresses, Map tab renders real Leaflet WebView (2 iframes with OSM tiles) and has Plan/Satellite toggle buttons (map-streets-btn / map-sat-btn), Profile tab exposes export-csv-btn, export-json-btn, sync-now-btn plus FR/EN switch and online dot, Address detail shows survey-cta which opens /survey/[id] with progress bar 'Question 1 / 21' and survey-back/next controls, New Address wizard now shows 5 steps (badges 1 2 3 4 5) with step 1 'Mesurer la Porte'. Backend JSON export returned 200 with items[].survey via frontend fetch. No red screens, no React Native deprecated packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). Expo reports several package version mismatches (warnings, app still works) — reported as minor.

issues: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — multiple style files still use shadow* on web. Cosmetic only.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo CLI reports version mismatches for installed Expo-managed packages. Expected by current expo SDK: @react-native-community/netinfo 11.4.1 (installed 12.0.1), expo-file-system ~19.0.22 (installed 56.0.7), expo-image-manipulator ~14.0.8 (installed 56.0.15), expo-sensors ~15.0.8 (installed 56.0.5), react-native-webview 13.15.0 (installed 13.16.1). App still bundles and runs on web, but may misbehave on native builds. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json

action_items: Recommend (low priority) running `npx expo install --check` and aligning the listed packages with versions expected by the current Expo SDK to avoid surprises on a native build.
Cosmetic: replace `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` with `style.pointerEvents` to silence web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is ~620 lines and still readable; no urgent split needed.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from all GET/list/export responses (verified by tests).
OTP code is properly deleted on successful verify (single-use enforced — verified).
